body.1: Disadvantage on STR and DEX checks
body.5: Disadvantage on STR and DEX saves

mind.1: Can't take the Dash, Disengage or Dodge actions
mind.7: Lose proficiency in all saving throws

soul.1: Disadvantage on WIS and CHA checks
soul.5: Disadvantage on WIS and CHA saves

Cosmetic.6: You become unbearably hungry or thirsty.

STM.MaintainHint: Strain to Maintain: keep every power you're concentrating on by gaining strain equal to their total order.
STM.SpendHdHint: After a short rest you can spend Hit Dice to remove strain, 1 per die.
STM.NoFeatures: No Talent features on this character yet. Use "Add missing Talent features" below, or add the class from the STM compendium.
STM.NoPowers: No powers known yet. Learn some below or through level-up.
STM.NoMatch: No known powers match this filter.
STM.Synced: Added {n} feature(s) from the STM compendium.
STM.OverMax: This takes you past your strain maximum, and you die.
STM.OverMaxManifest: This takes you past your strain maximum. Either manifest the power and die, or don't manifest it: you gain no strain and drop to 0 hit points.
STM.NoTest: 1st-order powers don't need a manifestation test.
STM.ScoreLine: Manifestation score {score} (order {order} + {n} other power(s) you're concentrating on). Roll a d{die}: higher, no strain; equal, 1 strain; lower, {strain} strain.
STM.ConcLimit: You're at your concentration limit ({limit}). Pick what to end.
STM.PickRoll: Adept reroll: pick the roll you keep.
STM.ReduceStress: Reduce Stress: halve the strain from the test ({n} use left)
STM.AssignHint: Choose how the {n} strain lands (test {test}, exertion {ex}).
STM.Refused: You hold the power back. It isn't manifested, you gain no strain, and you drop to 0 hit points.
STM.EnergyUnleashed: Energy Unleashed: a creature within 60 ft makes a DC {dc} WIS save or takes {n}d6 = {total} psychic damage.
STM.Death: Strain {total} exceeds the maximum of {max}. You die. If you're returned to life, you come back with strain equal to your maximum.
STM.FocusEffectHint: Talents can concentrate on as many powers as their proficiency bonus. Managed by STM.
STM.ManualHint: Manual adjustment, for features or rulings the tracker doesn't cover.
STM.FeatureRange: Gain {min}–{max} strain. Effects that scale with strain use this amount.
STM.NoStrainToRemove: You have no strain to remove.
STM.MaintainPrompt: You failed the Constitution save. All {n} power(s) you're concentrating on end, unless you gain strain equal to their total order.
STM.SpendHint: Remove 1 strain per Hit Die spent. {hd} Talent Hit Dice left.
STM.IgnorePrompt: Choose a strain type. You ignore its effects until your next long rest.
STM.Ignoring: Ignoring {type} strain effects until the next long rest.
STM.NothingToLearn: No powers available to learn at your level.
STM.LearnHint: Reaction: when a creature within 30 ft manifests a power you can learn, roll your manifestation die. Higher than the power's order and you begin learning it.
STM.LearnOk: You begin learning it. Practise 1 hour a day for {days} day(s).
STM.LearnTie: A tie isn't covered by the rules. Treated as a failure (GM's call).
STM.LearnFail: You fail to learn it and can't try again until you finish a long rest.

resourceSlot.Name: Show strain as a sheet resource
resourceSlot.Hint: Mirror total strain and the strain maximum into one of the character's resources, so it shows on the sheet header and token bars. Edit strain on the Psionics tab; the resource is overwritten from it.

automateDeath.Name: Apply strain death and 0 HP
automateDeath.Hint: When strain exceeds the maximum, set HP to 0 and death saves to 3 failures. When a talent refuses to manifest, set HP to 0.

cosmeticEffects.Name: Roll optional cosmetic strain effects
cosmeticEffects.Hint: Roll on the Optional Strain Effects table (d8) whenever a talent gains strain.

halveHealing.Name: Halve healing at soul strain 7
halveHealing.Hint: Healing applied through damage application is halved while soul strain 7 is in effect.

maintainPrompt.Name: Offer Strain to Maintain
maintainPrompt.Hint: After a failed concentration save, offer to keep concentrated powers by gaining strain.

restPrompt.Name: Rest prompts
restPrompt.Hint: After a short rest, offer to spend Hit Dice on strain. After a long rest at 20th level, ask which strain type to ignore.
